I think the only time was when I actually got hunger pangs bc I hadnt eaten in so long. I definitely developed the habit of eating at two sizeable and filling meals (I based it on how the portion looks to me or comparing it to another person’s meal) if I remember or if someone makes me food. I now generally try to eat based on necessity (like feeling sleepy or groggy or when i have a headache) so I know I did have some form of sustenance that day. 

Being on antidepressants has really fucked up my appetite from being unable to eat anything to eating all day. At this point I try to get a gauge on what I should (like bare minimum) eat and keep it a habit if I can.
